z-m-20-01.title: Shin jimillar furuci biyu masu murabba’i koyaushe furuci mai murabba’i ne?
z-m-20-01.goal: Ka bayyana yadda matsayi ke canzawa a jimilla da samfurin polynomial, kana bambanta misalai da hujjoji.
z-m-20-01.material: Polynomial A da B duka furucin quadratic ne a x. Ma'anarsa coefficient na x² ba 0 ba ne (ana karanta x² 'x murabba'i'), kuma duk coefficients ainihin lambobi ne. Matsayi shi ne na mafi girman term wanda coefficient ɗinsa ba 0 ba ne. Misali, x²+3x furucin quadratic ne, 2 kuma yana da matsayi 0. Ba za mu yi la'akari da yanayin da A+B ko A−B yake zama 0 ba. Seoyeon ta ce, "Idan ka tara furucin quadratic, kana samun quadratic; idan ka ninka su, kana samun furucin matsayi 4."
z-m-20-01.thinking.0: Gwada furucin 'koyaushe' da misalin da ke karyata shi
z-m-20-01.thinking.1: Kwatanta jimilla da samfur, ka yi tunani wanne ne zai iya rasa term mafi girman matsayi
z-m-20-01.thinking.2: Ka ƙirƙiri misalanka da suka cika sharuddan
z-m-20-01.prereq.0: H1 a wannan aiki yana nuna matakin wahala da taimako na wannan rukuni kawai; ba matakin aji ba ne. A ɗauka ka san tara, ragi da ninkawar polynomial na makarantar sakandare, ka'idojin ninkawa da warware ƙaƙƙarfan ƙima.
z-m-20-01.prereq.1: Ma'anar matsayi da term mafi girman matsayi na polynomial
z-m-20-01.prereq.2: Samfurin lambobi biyu marasa sifili ba 0 ba ne
z-m-20-01.s.s1.prompt: Idan A da B furucin quadratic ne da suka cika sharadin sama, zaɓi duk furucin da yake gaskiya koyaushe ko da wane furuci biyu ka zaɓa.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.hint.0: Idan furuci gaskiya ne koyaushe, dole ne ya tabbata ga kowane furuci quadratic biyu da ka saka. Zaɓi furuci quadratic biyu masu sauƙi, ka tara su ka ninka su, sannan ka duba matsayinsu.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.hint.1: A kowane jumla, gwada zaɓar A da B da za su sa jumlar ta zama ƙarya; idan ba za ka iya zaɓa ba, rubuta dalili.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.a: Ka faɗi 'koyaushe' ba tare da gwada yanayin da jimillar coefficients na x² take 0 ba.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukuncin ya lura cewa tara abubuwa yana tara coefficients na terms masu matsayi iri ɗaya ne kawai, don haka ba a samun sabon term mai matsayi mafi girma.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukuncin yana duba waɗanne terms biyu ne suke samar da term mafi girman matsayi na samfurin.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.o.d: Matsayin A−B koyaushe bai kai 2 ba.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi tunanin term mafi girman matsayi yana ɓacewa idan an yi ragi. Yana ɓacewa ne kawai idan coefficients biyu na x² sun yi daidai. Misali, idan A=x² kuma B=2x², to A−B=−x².
z-m-20-01.s.s1.o.e: Coefficient na term x⁴ a A×B na iya zama 0.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.e: Ka ɗauko yadda jimilla take aiki ka yi amfani da shi kai tsaye ga samfur. Ka yi tunanin yadda ake samo coefficient na term mafi girman matsayi na samfurin.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.explain: b da c suna aiki ga kowace biyu na furucin quadratic. a yana karyewa idan jimillar coefficients biyu na x² ta zama 0; d kuma yana karyewa idan coefficients ɗin sun bambanta. Dalilin da ya sa e bai tabbata ba za ka bayyana a mataki na ƙarshe.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.prompt: Bari A=ax²+bx+1, B=cx²+dx+2 (a, b, c, d ainihin lambobi ne). Ƙirƙiri misalai biyu masu furuci dabam inda A da B duka quadratic ne amma A+B ba quadratic ba ne.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta yadda za a bayyana coefficient na x² a A+B ta amfani da a da c.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi a ta yadda wannan coefficient ya zama 0, sannan ka daidaita c da shi. Zaɓi b da d yadda kake so, ka tara don dubawa.

z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Idan coefficient na x², c, a B ya zama 0, to B ba furucin quadratic ba ne.

z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Har yanzu akwai term x² a A+B. Nemo coefficient na x² na A+B ka duba.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.explain: Misali, idan A=x²+2x+1 kuma B=−x²+5x+2, to A+B=7x+3, wanda furucin linear ne. Idan A=2x²+3x+1 kuma B=−2x²+3x+2, to A+B=6x+3. Dukansu furuci ne na quadratic, amma idan jimillar coefficients na x² ta zama 0, jimillar ba quadratic ba ce. Don haka 'tara furucin quadratic yana ba da quadratic' ba koyaushe gaskiya ba ne.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.prompt: A cikin furucin Seoyeon, 'tara yana ba da quadratic' ya karye, amma 'ninkawa yana ba da furucin matsayi 4' bai karye ba. Ka bayyana da kalmominka dalilin da ya sa term mafi girman matsayi ba zai ɓace a samfur ba, kana kwatanta shi da jimilla.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo wanne term na A da wanne na B dole ne a ninka domin samar da term x⁴ a A×B.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.hint.1: Coefficient na x² a A+B shi ne a+c. Rubuta yadda coefficient na x⁴ a A×B yake samuwa, ka kwatanta su.

z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.0: A jimilla, muna tara coefficients na x², kuma a+c na iya zama 0, saboda haka term x² zai iya ɓacewa. A samfur, coefficient na term mafi girman matsayi shi ne ac, samfurin a da c. Idan a da c duka ba 0 ba ne, ac ma ba 0 ba ne, don haka term x⁴ koyaushe yana nan.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.1: Idan muka ninka, samfurin terms masu matsayi mafi girma shi ne term x⁴, kuma wannan ne kaɗai samfurin da ke samar da x⁴, don haka babu wani term da zai soke shi. Coefficient ɗin ma samfurin lambobi biyu marasa sifili ne, don haka ba 0 ba ne. A jimilla, + da − na iya haɗuwa su zama 0, term ya ɓace; amma hakan ba ya faruwa a samfur.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.2: Misali, a cikin (x²+1)(−x²+2), x⁴ guda ɗaya kawai shi ne x²×(−x²)=−x⁴, kuma ma'aunin −1 ba 0 ba ne, saboda haka furuci ne mai digiri 4. A jimillar (x²+1)+(−x²+2), ma'aunin x² ya zama 1+(−1)=0, don haka kalmar x² ta ɓace. [Lambobi kamar yadda aka bayar: 1, 2, 1, 0, 4, 1, 2, 1, 1, 0].

z-m-20-05.title: Me za mu iya sani game da ma'aunai ba tare da buɗe furucin ba?
z-m-20-05.topic: Nemo jimillar ma'aunai ta saka ƙimomi ga x
z-m-20-05.goal: Ba tare da buɗe furucin ba, ka bambanta bayanin ma'aunai da za ka iya sani daga ƙimomin x=0, 1, −1 da wanda ba za ka iya sani ba. Ka nemo ka gyara kuskure a warwarewa, sannan ka nuna cewa akwai furucin aljebra da dama da suke da bayanai iri ɗaya.
z-m-20-05.material: Idan aka buɗe P(x)=(x²−x−1)³ gaba ɗaya, zai zama furuci mai daraja 6 mai sharuɗɗa daga x⁶ har zuwa adadi tsayayye. Karatu: P(x) ‘x murabba'i cire x cire 1 a cikin baka, duk a kubik’ ne. Muna son samun bayanin ma'aunai ba tare da buɗewa ba. Ana iya samun P(0), P(1), da P(−1) cikin sauƙi ta saka ƙimomi kai tsaye a cikin baka. Za mu rubuta furucin da aka buɗe a matsayin P(x)=a₆x⁶+a₅x⁵+a₄x⁴+a₃x³+a₂x²+a₁x+a₀ (karatu: a₆ ‘a shida’ ne, kuma lambar da ke ƙasa suna ne da ke nuna daraja).
